description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime component, covering trigger detection, content trimming, language handling, and command extraction functionalities.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntimeTests
classes.description: A struct that contains test functions for verifying the behavior of VoiceWakeRuntime's trigger detection and command parsing functionalities.

methods.name: trims after trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Tests if the trimming function correctly retains speech after a trigger phrase.

methods.name: trims after trigger returns original when no trigger
methods.description: Verifies that if no trigger is present, the input text remains unchanged.

methods.name: trims after first matching trigger
methods.description: Checks that the trimming function stops at the first trigger occurrence.

methods.name: has content after trigger false when only trigger
methods.description: Ensures the detection function reports no content when only a trigger phrase is present.

methods.name: has content after trigger true when speech continues
methods.description: Ensures the detection function reports content after the trigger when speech follows.

methods.name: trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Tests trigger detection and trimming for Chinese trigger phrases.

methods.name: trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms
methods.description: Checks that the trimming function correctly handles full-width character forms.

methods.name: gate requires gap between trigger and command
methods.description: Verifies that command gating enforces a minimum gap between trigger and command.

methods.name: gate accepts gap and extracts command
methods.description: Checks that command extraction works when the gap condition is satisfied.

methods.name: gate command text handles foreign string ranges
methods.description: Tests that command text extraction correctly handles ranges from foreign language segments.
